description.en-US: Father Brown's last collection: The Scandal of Father Brown, The Quick One, The Blast of the Book, The Green Man, The Pursuit of Mr Blue, The Crime of the Communist, The Point of a Pin, The Insoluble Problem, and The Vampire of the Village.
description.pt-BR: A última coletânea do Padre Brown: O Escândalo do Padre Brown, O Rápido, O Sopro do Livro, O Homem Verde, A Perseguição do Sr. Blue, O Crime do Comunista, A Ponta de um Alfinete, O Problema Insolúvel e O Vampiro da Aldeia.

sources.edition: The Scandal of Father Brown (London: Cassell, 1935), Project Gutenberg Australia, ebooks02/0201031h.
sources.description: Chapter divisions as printed; Gutenberg front and back matter dropped, line wraps joined, underscored italics converted, double hyphens set as em dashes. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Public domain in Brazil, the UK and the EU (Chesterton died in 1936). Published in 1935; text taken from Project Gutenberg Australia, which carries it under Australian law.
